target: forge.sh pr-state — a /pull/ URL on an undeclared host never reaches gh; github.com and a host declared via FORGE=github plus a matching remote do
cmd:
. "$FIXTURES/forge/setup.sh"; fx_init
fx_remote https://github.com/o/r.git
fx_gh pr_view 0 MERGED
fx_run pr-state https://ghe.example.test/o/r/pull/3; fx_show foreign
echo "foreign_calls=$(fx_ncalls)"; echo "foreign_requests=$(fx_nreq)"
fx_reqs_clear
fx_run pr-state https://github.com/o/r/pull/3; fx_show com
echo "com_gh_views=$(fx_count gh pr view)"
fx_reqs_clear
fx_setremote https://ghe.example.test/o/r.git
export FORGE=github
fx_run pr-state https://ghe.example.test/o/r/pull/3; fx_show ghe
echo "ghe_gh_views=$(fx_count gh pr view)"
fx_done
